notes: researchers.mgh.harvard.edu is a 'Find a Researcher' search portal with no browsable roster (query-only, no results without a search term). research.massgeneralbrigham.org routes to the same MGB-wide institutes/centers/labs search tool already documented in bwh-research.json and mgh-lab-search.json (606 results, 555 labs, ~61 pages, no hospital filter found). Not duplicating that crawl here. Recommend the same future dedicated pass, bucketing by home institution, serve all of bwh-research/mgh-lab-search/mgh-research-institute/meei-research at once. Update 2026-11-02: the MGB-wide search has now been crawled in full into mgh-lab-search.json (547 labs across MGH, BWH, McLean, Mass Eye and Ear and Spaulding; each lab's hospital, where its page names one, is in that lab's notes), so this target is covered there rather than duplicated here.
